scenes.name: Corridor Chimes & Fingerpicked Prelude
scenes.subtitle: Sunlight slanting across polished wooden corridor • An old excuse to walk past Class 10-B

scenes.name: Wooden Pass & The Stolen Walk
scenes.subtitle: Holding the corridor pass with trembling hands • Stolen glances across the classroom window

lines.text: Paani peene ka toh bas ek bahaana tha,
Mujhe tere classroom ke aage se jaana tha.
Haath mein wooden pass, dheeme se kadam,
Tujhe mud ke dekhne ka khwaab puraana tha.
Class ki khidki se jab dhoop chhan ke aati,
Teri bench pe gir ke woh noor ban jaati.
Haan paani peene ka toh bas bahaana tha,
Mujhe tere classroom ke aage se jaana tha!

scenes.name: Corridor Footsteps & Bell Chime
scenes.subtitle: Acoustic strings echo through quiet high school corridors • Memories of youth

scenes.name: Morning Assembly & Recess Tiffin
scenes.subtitle: Turning around during the morning prayer • Sneaking glances behind lunchbox lids

lines.text: Subah ki assembly mein lambi si line thi,
Dono ke beech bas do chaar deewarein thin.
Prayer ke beech mein main gardan ghumata,
Tujhe dhoondhne mein hi ik sukoon paata.
Ek baar galti se aankhein jo mil gayin,
Puri din ki thakan chupke se dhal gayi.
Tu aage waali row mein baithi thi khamosh,
Aur aakhri bench pe udta mera hosh!
Recess ki ghanti pe dabba kholna,
Doston se chhipaa ke tera rukh dekhna.

scenes.name: Bina Baat Ke Dhadakta Dil
scenes.subtitle: The heart beats without reason • A love that never needed words

lines.text: Bina baat ke hi dil dhadakne lagta tha,
Yeh masoom sa lamha kitna suhaana tha.
Paani peene ka toh bas ek bahaana tha,
Mujhe tere classroom ke aage se jaana tha!

scenes.name: The Borrowed Pencil & Tangled Equations
scenes.subtitle: Sharpening a pencil halfway down with trembling hands • Science period daydreams

lines.text: Ik din jo maangi thi tune woh pencil,
Aadhi chhil ke di maine kitni mushkil se.
Uss naye se shikhar pe jo tera lams tha,
Jaise mere hisse ka sabse bada jashn tha.

scenes.name: Acoustic Solo & Campus Sunset
scenes.subtitle: Melodic acoustic strings dance across the school courtyard • Golden dust motes in suspension

scenes.name: The Saved Eraser & Timeless Innocence
scenes.subtitle: Kept safe in an old uniform pocket • The innocence of loving from afar

lines.text: Na kabhi tu samajh paayi mera yeh marz,
Purani uniform ki jeb mein aaj bhi,
Tera gira eraser mehfooz hai kahin...
Haan mehfooz hai kahin!
Woh bachpana bhi kitna ajeeb tha,
Jitna door tha tu, utna kareeb tha.

scenes.name: Two Benches Apart & The Last Look
scenes.subtitle: Sitting on the back bench watching you • A bittersweet memory preserved forever

lines.text: Do bench aage tu... aakhri bench pe main...
Corridor ke mod pe dhoondhta raha chain...
Paani peene ka toh bas ek bahaana tha...
Tujhe door se bas ek baar dekh aana tha...
